title: baliospermum calycinum var. micranthum
intro: Baliospermum calycinum var. micranthum, commonly known as Bala or Chakravyuha, is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Ayurveda, to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antidiabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Baliospermum calycinum var. micranthum include wound healing, pain relief, and fever reduction, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. These constituents also exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer activities, further solidifying the plant's potential in traditional and modern medicine.
